result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback position: it provides a mutual cap at least equal to 12 months’ fees and uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and, assuming Sections 13 or 14 address confidentiality as the comment states, confidentiality. It does not fully reach the preferred position because data-protection and security breaches are not expressly carved out, and the lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. It is not fully minimal because the final sentence exempts Excluded Claims from all limitations in Section 15, potentially disapplying the indirect/consequential-damages exclusion—not merely the monetary cap—for every carve-out.
